entities.name: NAS message container
entities.description: An information element that contains NAS messages, included when UE sends SERVICE REQUEST as initial NAS message and needs to send non-cleartext IEs.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: A NAS message used by UE to request establishment of NAS signaling connection and user plane resources.

entities.name: UE sending SERVICE REQUEST as initial NAS message
entities.description: Condition where UE sends SERVICE REQUEST message as the first NAS message in a transaction.

entities.name: UE needs to send non-cleartext IEs
entities.description: Condition where UE requires transmission of information elements that are not in cleartext format.

relations.description: SERVICE REQUEST message contains NAS message container IE under specified conditions.
Inclusion of NAS message container IE is guarded by condition that SERVICE REQUEST is sent as initial NAS message.
Inclusion of NAS message container IE is guarded by condition that UE needs to send non-cleartext IEs.
